title: Synthesis of heterobicyclo[n.1.1]alkanes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,941-954
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01128K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rebecca I. Revie, Julia Ragus, Edward A. Anderson
The rise of small bridged rings as 3D building blocks in drug design has fuelled the development of routes to heterobicyclo[n.1.1]alkanes. This review describes strategies to access such scaffolds, featuring a variety of heteroatoms and substituents.
